simple.summary: כֵּף (kêph) means a hollow rock First listed occurrence: Jer 4 29.

definitions.full: H3710. keph [ כֵּף ] noun [masculine] rock (Assyrian kâpu Dl HWB 346 ; Aramaic כֵּיפָא , perhaps Aramaic loan-word in Hebrew; √ dubious); — only plural כֵּפִים Jer 4:29 as place of refuge; Job 30:6 as dwelling-place.
